column1: Table: Identification of wheat leaf samples and their infection status.

column8: [1]: The number of pot containing durum wheat (Triticum turgidum subsp durum) plants varies from 01 to 48 pots according to the date.
[2]: The G column represents the left side of the pot, while the D column represents the right side of the pot.
[3]: 1 to 3 wheat leaves per pot's side were imaged by HSI for each pot
[4]: EPO_67 and EPO_68 refer to two durum wheat genotypes originating from the David et al. (2014) Evolutionnary Pre-breeding pOpulation (EPO).  https://doi.org/10.1007/s11032-014-0179-z.

[5]: "Infected" plants were inoculated with the Zymoseptoria tritici strain P1a dissolved in distilled water/Tween 20 mixture at a concentration of 1.106 spores/mL. “Non-infected” plants were inoculated with distilled water/Tween 20 mixture only.
[6]: The confiendence level of infection is defined based on visual evalution of symptoms. "1" stands for high confidence level while "2" stands for low confidence level.
